principles: Only repair evidence-chain contradictions that reviewers confirmed as real correctness issues.
Preserve B-688d capability conclusions and authority boundaries exactly.
Prefer deterministic artifact normalization and hash refresh over redesigning runner behavior.
drivers: Reviewer-visible provenance must be internally coherent after merge.
Local artifacts must not reference deleted worktree paths.
Failure text must not contradict structured terminalCriteria fields.

options.name: A: Patch merged artifacts narrowly and refresh hashes
pros: Preserves existing decision and authority semantics
cons: Does not fix the upstream baseline_suite_report generator that produced the wording

options.name: B: Change baseline runner generator
pros: Could prevent recurrence for future reports
cons: Out of scope for a merged artifact correction
Higher blast radius and not needed to fix the current user-visible contradiction

options.name: C: Record findings only without fixing artifacts
cons: Leaves known incorrect provenance in committed artifacts

chosen: A: Patch merged artifacts narrowly and refresh hashes
rationale: Choose the smallest correction that makes the committed evidence chain true without changing capability claims or implementing unrelated generator work.

preMortem.scenario: Hash refresh misses a dependent artifact
preMortem.trigger: shared-contract evidenceRefs still point to old SHA values
preMortem.mitigation: Run a Node consistency check that recomputes every referenced SHA.

preMortem.trigger: edited final-report or suite counters drift from GO-NOT-YET
preMortem.consequence: Review appears to unlock capability incorrectly
preMortem.mitigation: Assert decision, suiteStatus, locks, and authority fields in verification.

preMortem.trigger: all run paths are collapsed too aggressively
preMortem.consequence: Reviewers cannot locate baseline run files
preMortem.mitigation: Convert deleted worktree absolute paths to current repo-relative artifact paths.
